test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

GAIN : HBKP :: ACHE : BDJG :: CAKE : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

1) GAIN : HBKP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da9bf8b23e3e7999bbc5190c2aa4991826ce00dba5469a16215e38d86e4c2b29.png] 

And,

2) ACHE : BDJG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dc5f97dbc9d5010591caaeabb8dc341ba3967a9149ce8565f0b05856c58d3e2.png] 

Similarly,

3) CAKE : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5ae0413c3e6c45cf95ee4a5af3c627030a550791454a5374896a45e6f329d4e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"DBMG".**
